name: Library of Sealed Time Capsules
description: A warm old library filled with glass and brass time capsules, each holding a tiny miniature scene of a lost moment.
prompt: A single cozy image of an old library with tall shelves filled with glass and brass time capsules. Each capsule contains a tiny miniature scene: a rainy street, a garden, a train station, a mountain path. Warm lamplight, dust motes, wooden floor, deep shadows, nostalgic, hyper-detailed, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Which moment would you keep inside a capsule?
